name: agentsmd
oneLiner: First Vibe Builder Toolkit tool: agent configs, AI-assisted AGENTS.md, build conductor, capability handoffs, and OSS maintainer workflows.
conventions: Before working, run `git fetch` (both Claude Code and Codex push to this repo) and read docs/PRODUCT_STRATEGY.md (plan) and CHANGELOG.md (current status).
Zero runtime dependencies: use Node built-ins only (node:util parseArgs, node:fs, node:path, node:child_process).
ESM modules; always use explicit .js extensions in relative imports.
Single source of truth: generators read agentsmd.config.json; never hand-edit generated files.
Each command lives in src/commands/, each output target in src/render/.
Capability cards live in capabilities/*.json and are rendered by src/lib/capabilities.js.
Runner handoffs may write command plans, prompts, manifests, and run summaries, but they must not execute third-party tools until a reviewed adapter exists.
doNot: Do not add runtime npm dependencies without a strong, documented reason.
Do not hard-code secrets; .mcp.json env values must use ${VAR} placeholders.
Do not let the conductor invoke coding agents automatically until run --auto is intentionally designed and documented.
security: Never commit API keys or .env files.
Recipe check commands are code the user runs: keep them transparent and minimal.
Capability runner handoffs must keep --yes consent separate from third-party execution support.
reviewCriteria: agentsmd gen on a sample project still produces all four targets.
New commands are documented in README.md and cli.js help.
priorities: Keep v0.9 focused on OSS maintainer readiness and tagged-release preparation.
Make --ai mode reliable for Korean profile -> English AGENTS.md generation.
Keep third-party execution disabled until a reviewed local-runner adapter is implemented and tested.
